diagnostics.message: Vulkan reports NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 A Laptop GPU (vendor 10de device 28a3) on attempt 1; deviceLUIDValid=true
--force-unavailable discarded the Vulkan LUID to exercise the IdentityUnavailable branch; this is a synthetic condition, not a limitation of this machine

Vulkan reported no valid deviceLUID for NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 A Laptop GPU, so no DXGI adapter can be matched to it. 3 DXGI adapter(s) were enumerable, but matching by name or taking the first would substitute an adapter the renderer did not choose (spec 9.7).
